svg.aria-label: United States Virgin Islands actual islands, coastlines and real landmarks
svg.metadata: USVI land geometry including Buck Island and Hassel Island: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, extracted by hyperknot/country-levels-export from OSM admin level 2 (https://github.com/hyperknot/country-levels-export/blob/master/geojson/high/iso1/VI.geojson; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). Target land preserves actual coordinates without relocation or invented shapes; 25 island polygons including Buck Island off Saint Croix. British Virgin Islands context: GSHHS intermediate coastline, Basemap 2.0.0, Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith, LGPL-3.0-or-later. WGS84, local-equirectangular-fit-v1, viewBox 1200x760. Real locations use independently sourced coordinates.
